implementation: Typed layout preference preserves original boolean key and explicit false import/reopen. Native searchable switch;55 Settings entries.

Public NSClipView.documentRect supplies a minimum document extent without changing source or fighting TextKit2 private frame updates; original scroll insets and automatic adjustment restore on disable.

Native text segments identify the last visible grapheme row. Extend scrolling only enough to bring that row to the normal top margin; native scrolling or authored blank tails may already provide sufficient range. No EOF caret query, Markdown parsing or source rewriting. Cache source scans by document/revision/load/UTF16 length and geometry by width/inset/font/spacing/usage bounds.
Full window resize and persistent/overlay scrollbars retain last-row reach and native column width. Source/attributes/selection/revision/undo and TextKit2 stay intact.
Marked Chinese/Japanese text defers preference effects. Linked/unlinked reading anchors survive toggling. Scroll coordinator reads native constrained maximum including insets.
Native source paper also fills its scroll view. Normal zero/default feature path retains native clip behavior.

The first composition test incorrectly expected marked attributes to remain after unmarking; assert they remain during preedit, and preserve text across the native unmark operation.
Tuist does not treat a worktree .git file as a root directory. An empty local Tuist directory is the isolated-only root marker; no product/build-script change was made.

New typography runs show reported native usage height refining by96...500 points across viewport visits. Comparing final extent with the initial reported height was an invalid invariant. Restoration now compares with an unmodified native NSClipView using the current document frame; source/history and actual last-row reach remain asserted.

The maximum-font CRLF case already had sufficient native range, but the previous content/trailing-height formula still added7 points. Targeting the actual last visible row removes that unnecessary extension and passes all96 typography/source/scroller combinations.
